raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (349 rows, ingested 2026-01-17) arrived with source_tz='UTC' while every other batch is America/Chicago local time, and the pipeline ignores source_tz. Evening transactions from 2026-01-16 therefore fall onto 2026-01-17 at 00:00-06:00, which inflates that day and shrinks 2026-01-16. Converting the UTC rows to Chicago time (CST, UTC-6 in January, no DST in this data range) restores the correct timestamps and dates.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
